newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian shares close quietly firm ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: Latvian shares close quietly firm ahead of results.

text.p: Latvian shares closed modestly higher in quiet trade, looking forward to a burst of corporate half year results ahead of the bourse deadline later this week.
Total market turnover was 63,000 lats versus 62,000 lats on Friday and the bourse index climbed 0.67 percent to 378.10.
Unibanka again stood out with the highest trade as it edged up slightly to 3.20 lats from 3.17 on turnover of 34,700 lats.
It has maintained a steady recovery in recent sessions after sliding on news that the state is to sell one million shares in the bank at a minimum 3.05 lats.
Some traders were optimistic over the market short-term.
"This week should bring more if not all of official and secondary list half-year results, which may lead to higher activity," said Uldis Bulavs, a dealer with Trasta Bank.
July 25 is the bourse deadline for profit reports to be submitted.
"Unibanka will generate some movement ahead of its one million share auction next Monday," Bulavs added. "Some are thinking of selling quickly and buying at 3.05 lats."
The Unibanka share auction has been set for July 28.
On the secondary list trade was thin apart from Jekabpils Sugar and Lode Brick, which traded 6,400 lats and 3,300 lats respectively.
Jekabpils, had gained earlier after good first half-year results, but lost 11 santimes or 15 percent today to 0.63 santimes. Lode lost one santime to 2.20 lats.
